blocks.text: Jennylyn Mercado is set to portray a transgender woman for the first time in her acting career in the upcoming episode of GMA Network’s “Magpakailanman.” The Kapuso actress will headline “Mama’s Cradle: The Carina Suarez a.k.a. Francisco Suarez Story,” which will air on Nov. 21 as part of the drama anthology’s 24th anniversary specials. The episode follows the life of Carina Suarez, also known as Francisco Suarez, a transgender woman, breadwinner and dog lover who faces a terminal illness.
